svg.title: The Timur SoC on the DE10-Lite
svg.desc: Architecture of the Timur SoC: the CPU core and DMA master share an AHB-Lite fabric to ROM, RAM, VGA and an APB bridge to UART, GPIO and DMA registers, with clock, reset and interrupt paths.
